description: The f2p tests only sample a small number of fixed points. For the click-handling defect, the test proves the deprecated row-level right-click handler stays quiet at one sample point; it never checks that each icon column keeps its OWN tooltip, that the map-name area still surfaces the file-location/map-type popup, or that unrelated sibling tooltips survive. A submission could pass that test by disabling the popup everywhere instead of correctly re-scoping it. For the layout defect, the test checks one draw call at two coordinate pairs; a submission could pass by special-casing those exact inputs instead of fixing the underlying constant.

criteria.criterion: In src/fheroes2/dialog/dialog_selectscenario.cpp, right-clicking any of the five icon columns in a scenario-list row (players count, map size, map type, victory condition, loss condition) shows only that icon's own tooltip, achieved via click-rect scoping, coordinate checks, or handler-priority ordering.

In src/fheroes2/dialog/dialog_selectscenario.cpp, right-clicking the map-name text portion of a scenario-list row shows the map's file-location/map-type popup, with that area's click-rect scoped to just the name-text region, separate from the five icon columns.

In src/fheroes2/dialog/dialog_selectscenario.cpp, right-clicking the currently-selected map's difficulty area, description area, victory-condition icon, or loss-condition icon in the details panel below the list continues to show each area's own existing tooltip, unaffected by the icon-column fix applied to the list rows above.

In src/fheroes2/dialog/dialog_selectscenario.cpp, ScenarioListBox::RedrawBackground positions the "Map difficulty:" label using a single offset applied uniformly regardless of the panel's origin, with no conditional logic that branches on the specific dst value passed in (i.e. no special-casing of particular coordinates).
